Global (All).title: North Korea Launches Ballistic Missile Test
Global (All).summary: In a provocative move, North Korea has launched a ballistic missile test, increasing tensions in the region.

Global (All).title: US-China Trade Tensions Escalate
Global (All).summary: Tensions between the US and China have escalated, with both countries imposing new trade restrictions.

Global (All).title: Cyberattack on European Healthcare System Disrupted
Global (All).summary: A recent cyberattack on a European healthcare system has caused significant disruptions to patient care.

United States.title: Florida judge blocks new law requiring schools to report LGBTQ+ students to parents
United States.summary: A Florida judge has blocked a new law requiring schools to report LGBTQ+ students to parents, arguing that it violates the rights of students and is unconstitutional.

United States.title: US Supreme Court allows Texas abortion ban to take effect
United States.summary: The US Supreme Court has allowed a Texas abortion ban to take effect, marking a significant setback for abortion rights in the country.

United States.title: US and Israel reach agreement on Iran nuclear deal
United States.summary: The US and Israel have reached an agreement on the Iran nuclear deal, with Israel agreeing to support the deal in exchange for concessions from the US on military aid and security cooperation.

South Korea.title: Ruling Party's Election Fund Scandal Deepens
South Korea.summary: North Korea's foreign minister warned that the country will 'never' return to nuclear talks with South Korea, as it seeks stronger relations with China and Russia, after Seoul and Washington agreed on new military drills to counter growing threats from Pyongyang.

South Korea.title: South Korean Economy Shrinks Again, Heightening Recession Fears
South Korea.summary: South Korea has become the latest major economy to see its GDP shrink, heightening concerns that the country could tip into recession. Experts say the outlook is grim due to weak exports, lower investment and rising uncertainty over the global economic outlook.

South Korea.title: North Korean ICBM Test Sparks Fears of Escalating Conflict
South Korea.summary: North Korea has fired a long-range missile which appeared to land near Japan, sparking concerns over escalating tensions in the region and fears that the country's nuclear programme is advancing at a rapid pace.

Japan.title: Japan's Defense Ministry confirms missile detected over northern island of Hokkaido, but no explosion reported.
Japan's ruling party to revise defense guidelines, consider increasing troop presence on remote islands and boosting missile intercept capabilities.
Japanese government to impose stricter COVID-19 measures on Tokyo and surrounding regions due to rising cases.
